summary: This update improves conversations, plugin management, and overall reliability.

items.text: See queued messages immediately after sending.
Enjoy more stable formatting as responses stream in.
Annotate content, view grouped commands, and adjust model thinking modes.
Select image models and upload multiple images.
Import and export plugins in a portable format.
Benefit from improvements to platform notification delivery.
Includes updates to server stability, backups, deployment, and session handling.
